##### Project general facts

The Liberty by Wallaya Villas is a low-rise residential development by Wallaya Villas Development, created in collaboration with NUZEN Limited. The project comprises five residential buildings of seven storeys each, defined by an architecture of bold glass facades, sharp vertical lines, and warm accents. Floor-to-ceiling windows shape the elevations and give the buildings a light, contemporary silhouette. The collection spans 324 residences across one- and two-bedroom apartments, penthouses, and corner penthouses, positioning the project as a modern, design-led offering with a measured, understated character.

Residents are served by swimming pools set within landscaped communal gardens that run through the heart of the site, alongside a fitness centre for day-to-day wellness. The development also incorporates a dedicated retail and commercial component, a reception, and on-site security service, together with generous covered car parking and separate motorbike parking. The shared grounds combine water features, green landscaping, and open communal zones, creating calm, usable outdoor space between the buildings.

Interiors are organised around open-plan kitchen and dining areas, generous terraces, and walk-in closets, with floor-to-ceiling glazing drawing daylight deep into each residence. Kitchens are delivered built-in with integrated appliances, and the layouts prioritise space, storage, and a clear separation between living and sleeping zones. Finishing follows a modern approach with high-quality materials and a warm, neutral palette. The residences are fully furnished.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Choeng Thale stands as one of Phuket’s most prestigious and sophisticated coastal destinations, blending tropical tranquility with modern luxury living. Nestled along the island’s sought-after western shoreline, the area is renowned for its upscale residential communities, stylish resorts, and breathtaking natural surroundings. With its pristine beaches, elegant architecture, and relaxed yet vibrant atmosphere, Choeng Thale offers an exceptional lifestyle that reflects the refined charm of Phuket’s premium seaside living.

Choeng Thale is far more than a residential area — it is a destination centered around leisure, wellness, and recreation. The community features world-class beach clubs, luxury spas, fitness centers, golf courses, and scenic parks that create an ideal environment for relaxation and active living. Residents and visitors can enjoy easy access to stunning beaches such as Bang Tao and Surin, where crystal-clear waters and white sandy shores provide the perfect setting for coastal enjoyment.

The dynamic lifestyle of Choeng Thale is enriched by its impressive selection of retail, dining, and entertainment venues. Trendy cafes, fine dining restaurants, boutique shopping centers, and vibrant lifestyle hubs are seamlessly integrated throughout the area, ensuring everyday convenience alongside a cosmopolitan atmosphere. Additionally, Choeng Thale benefits from excellent connectivity to Phuket International Airport and other key destinations across the island, making it a highly desirable location for both permanent residence and holiday living.
